Firestore:users/{uid}:update:openMailbox.description: Opens receiver mailbox — publishes RSA public key and marks user ready

Firestore:users/{uid}:update:closeMailbo.description: Closes receiver mailbox (kill switch) — removes public key and authorization

Firestore:handshakes:batch:selectSenderH.description: Atomic WriteBatch: sets selectedSenderUid on receiver doc + upserts handshake doc with handshake_complete status

Firestore:handshakes:stream:streamHandsh.description: Real-time stream used by SenderScreen to detect receiver authorization

Firestore:transfers:uploadAndCreate.description: Uploads encrypted file to Storage then writes transfer document; yields progress stream 0.0→1.0

Firestore:transfers:stream:watchPendingT.description: Real-time stream used by ReceiverScreen to detect incoming file transfers

Firestore:transfers:update:updateReceive.description: Updates receiver-side status field for non-repudiation tracking

Firestore:transfer_logs:writeAuditLog.description: Writes immutable audit log entry for each completed transfer

Firestore:users/{uid}/notifications:add.description: Sends RSA key / file received / friend request notifications to user inbox

Firestore:users:searchUsers.path: users WHERE username >= query AND username <= query+\uf8ff LIMIT 10
Firestore:users:searchUsers.description: Username prefix search for finding connections

Firestore:users/connections:acceptConnec.description: Accepts friend request — atomic batch writes connection to both user docs

Storage:transfers/{id}:download.description: Downloads encrypted file bytes for decryption; max 100 MB

MethodChannel:isFlagSecureActive.description: Queries Kotlin MainActivity to verify FLAG_SECURE is active before 64 KB chunk reads

Auth:register.description: Creates Firebase Auth account + Firestore user document

Auth:loginWithUsername.description: Username-based login — resolves email from Firestore then signs in
